package.name: log_gazebo
package.description: Marine simulation behaviour for the floating_log model. Layers the VRX buoyancy (Surface), hydrodynamics (SimpleHydrodynamics) and wind (USVWind) plugins onto the pure body provided by log_description, mirroring the VRX wamv_description + wamv_gazebo separation of concerns. No thrusters, controllers or sensors are added at this phase.
